verdict.rationale: Logseq documents a `logseq://` protocol so third-party apps can invoke actions, including an x-callback-url quickCapture that can be opened from a bookmark or the command line. It also ships an opt-in local HTTP API server on 127.0.0.1:12315 with bearer-token auth, CORS, and a POST /api endpoint that dispatches any plugin-API method, with worked curl examples. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of URI deep links that open a specific page or block (the protocol docs only show quickCapture), a published OpenAPI spec or versioning policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.
